test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Including** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Including** means taking into account or comprising as part of a whole. (समग्र के भाग के रूप में ध्यान में रखना या शामिल करना) • **Example**: *The team members brought various snacks to the meeting, including cookies, fruits, and sandwiches.* • The word "**including**" is appropriate here because it introduces additional elements within the set of relationships between people. Therefore, **option 1** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Discounting**: Offering reduced prices or deductions on the original cost of goods or services. (वस्तुओं या सेवाओं की मूल लागत पर कम कीमतों या कटौती) • **Developing**: The process of growth, advancement, or creation; often used in the context of progress or improvement. (विकास, उन्नति या सृजन की प्रक्रिया) • **Resisting**: Opposing or withstanding an action, force, or influence. (किसी कार्य, बल या प्रभाव का विरोध करना या उसका सामना करना) 3f:Tb82, The correct answer is: **Entire**
